subject: New warning in lavaan 0.6-6: "estimation pearson correlation did not converge for..."

messages.author: f9a02a1a390eea1a
messages.subject: New warning in lavaan 0.6-6: "estimation pearson correlation did not converge for..."
parts:
Hi,

I have been fitting cfa and sem models using lavaan for a few weeks, but having updated to the latest version today I am now getting a warning on models that previously converged OK. Can someone tell me what this means and how to correct it please?

The warning  - repeated for up to 5 pairs of variables, within and across different latent factors - is:

lav_bvreg_cor_twostep_fit(fit.y1 = UNI[[i]], fit.y2 = UNI[[j]],  :   lavaan WARNING: estimation pearson correlation did not converge for variables ...[ names of two indicator variables ]

I've checked the residual correlations and these are a) present and b) OK (<0.1). What else should I look for?

As a background, this is fitted to a data set of approx 1000 observations; three of the indicator variables (all on the same latent variable) are treated as ordinal but the assumption of multivariate normality is violated in most of the continuous variables anyway. I am using the default DWLS  estimator with robust se's. Fit is thus far not satisfactory as far as model chi-squared is concerned - hence still playing with these models - but other fit measures were adequate (TLI, CFI, NFI all >0.95, RMSEA ~0.04). An example is below, though I'm getting these warnings for every model I'd previously fitted:

mod <- "
              S1 =~ ind1+ ind2
              S2 =~ ind3 + ind4 + ind5 + ind6
              S3 =~ ind7 + ind8 + ind9
              "
fit <- cfa(mod, std.lv=FALSE<, data=basedf, ordered=c("ind7","ind8","ind9"), missing="pairwise")

This is my first post on a forum ever - hope someone can help!

Many thanks,

Rebecca

messages.author: af8b3df1f270185a
messages.subject: Re: New warning in lavaan 0.6-6: "estimation pearson correlation did not converge for..."
parts:
Hi Rebecca, try a polychoric correlation. It's best for ordinal data.

Good luck!

Carlos

messages.subject: Re: New warning in lavaan 0.6-6: "estimation pearson correlation did not converge for..."
parts:
Hi Carlos, 

Thanks for your reply. I believe that this uses a polychoric correlation matrix by default as soon as the "ordered=" argument is specified in the call to cfa and sem (or even if it isn't, if the variables are already declared as ordered in the dataset). At least, the models do  estimate thresholds and intercepts which they would not for straightforward ML procedures. Do you think this is the reason for the warning?

Best wishes,

Rebecca

messages.subject: Re: New warning in lavaan 0.6-6: "estimation pearson correlation did not converge for..."
parts:
Hi Carlos,

Using listwise deletion does indeed help the simpler cfa models to run, but is not an option for the larger SEM model (with 17 indicator variables, listwise deletion removes around 45% and then convergence is a more general problem).

So it appears this warning is related to the "missing="pairwise"" argument, but it wasn't an issue until the new version of lavaan and I'm still not sure why not. Can anybody clarify why it is now appearing? I can just revert to the old version of lavaan but if it's telling me something about my model/data/misspecification then I'd prefer to know!

Thank you for your suggestions so far.

Rebecca

messages.subject: Re: New warning in lavaan 0.6-6: "estimation pearson correlation did not converge for..."

annoying but harmless, and will be removed in the next update.

Yves.
